findings.title: Stale continuation could target a changed dataset
findings.resolution: Continuation now validates active dataset identity and the exact pre-clarification state-version token before grouping or resumption.

findings.title: Model final response could claim unobserved success
findings.resolution: Success claims require an observed successful tool result; otherwise the response fails closed to deterministic fallback.

findings.title: Documentation/descriptive requests could reach mutation confirmation
findings.resolution: A shared clause-aware read-only guard runs before ReAct/model/tool mutation routing, with held-out documentation/manual/reference/role-play coverage and a positive mixed-clause contrast.

findings.title: Thrown authorization, confirmation, or tool failures escaped structured loop handling
findings.resolution: Authorization and confirmation exceptions stop fail-closed; tool exceptions become bounded actual-result observations.

findings.title: Custom Parser workflow proposal could borrow authority from an unrelated positive clause
findings.resolution: START_CUSTOM_PARSER_WORKFLOW now requires an explicit non-denied workflow clause; legitimate unsupported-file conversion remains reachable.

findings.title: Observation version omitted route and visualization state
findings.resolution: Input route, section, export preview, visual limit, graph view/layout/search are now observed and version-bound.

findings.title: Next ReAct observation could race a typed React state update
findings.resolution: Typed dispatch now yields two animation frames before the next authoritative observation; confirmation actions still stop immediately.

findings.title: Live Ollama model quality not qualified
findings.resolution: Ollama was not on PATH and localhost:11434 refused connection. Controlled responses validate workflow, not live-model quality.

findings.title: Development-only Browserslist advisory and large bundle advisory remain
findings.resolution: npm audit reports one High advisory in a dev-only transitive package; npm audit --omit=dev reports zero. Dependency modernization and unrelated chunk splitting were explicitly out of scope.
